units.rawText: Professor, are you here because you have a new investigation request for me, or do you wish to chat to help organize your thoughts?

units.rawText: ...Whenever I talk to you, I can't help but feel astounded by how easy yet agonizing it is to talk with someone who thrives on mind games.

units.rawText: You and I are cut from the same cloth, Professor. I've noticed it since the day we first met.

units.rawText: And it's been quite some time since then. I believe you've grown accustomed to it by now.

units.rawText: Of all the Dolls, only a rare few take such delight in inspecting and probing me, savoring every reaction I give.

units.rawText: I'm a detective. Observing and probing are just part of the job, and those habits tend to stick with me in my day-by-day... But I'll admit I've enjoyed observing you during all this time we've spent together.

units.rawText: But we can leave all that for later. Right now, we have more important matters to discuss. I've organized the information you provided, Professor, and pieced together as many clues as possible.
